WORKING NOTES

graphics.
- Keep the white cars for a clean, sleek background.

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair
in a messy updo wears a black and
white raglan long-sleeve tee with a large
gothic cross graphic and chain-link
detail. A black leather belt with a silver
buckle cinches black cargo trousers. Her
expression is calm and direct. A pale
backdrop with white cars at the sides.
Palette of black, white, and gunmetal.
Edgy and bold, in the style of a
streetwear graphic lookbook.
